{{nihongo|'''Kisa Shrine'''|岐佐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tōtōmi Province]].

'''Kisa Shrine''' (きさじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in Maisaka Town, Chūō Ward, Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture.

=== Enshrined Deities ===
* {{ill|Kisagaihime and Umugihime|ja|キサガイヒメ・ウムギヒメ|zh|蚶貝比賣與蛤貝比賣|qid=Q11296639|lt=Akagai-hime no Mikoto}} – Goddess of ark clams
* {{ill|Kisagaihime and Umugihime|ja|キサガイヒメ・ウムギヒメ|zh|蚶貝比賣與蛤貝比賣|qid=Q11296639|lt=Hamagai-hime no Mikoto}} – Goddess of clams

=== Overview ===
[[File:Kis-jinja.jpg|thumb|<center>Torii gate of Kisa Shrine</center>]]
In the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'' (927), it is listed as “one of the six shrines of Shikichi District among the sixty-two shrines of {{ill|Tōtōmi Province|Q1048864|qid=Q1048864}},” making it a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. In addition to serving as the local tutelary shrine, it has long been revered by fishermen as a guardian deity of fisheries and fishing<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese
  |author = Kisa Shrine
  |url = https://www.kisa-jinja.jp/about
  |title = History of Kisa Shrine
  |accessdate = 2016-07-31 }}</ref>.

=== History ===
The shrine was washed away along with the village of Maisawa by the tsunami of the {{ill|Meiō|Q1193841|qid=Q1193841}} era (1498). However, when the divine shrine washed ashore in the pine grove to the east (the present location), a shrine building was constructed there and the deity was enshrined.

The main hall was rebuilt in {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 2 (1574). In {{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 6 (1601), three koku of land bearing an ink seal were granted by Ina Bizen-no-kami, and thereafter five koku bearing vermilion seals were granted by the third shogun {{ill|Tokugawa Iemitsu|ar|توكوغاوا إيميتسو|br|Tokugawa Iemitsu|ca|Tokugawa Iemitsu|cs|Iemicu Tokugawa|de|Tokugawa Iemitsu|es|Tokugawa Iemitsu|eu|Tokugawa Iemitsu|fa|توکوگاوا ایه‌میتسو|fi|Tokugawa Iemitsu|fr|Tokugawa Iemitsu|hak|Tokugawa Iemitsu|hu|Tokugava Iemicu|id|Tokugawa Iemitsu|is|Tokugawa Iemitsu|it|Tokugawa Iemitsu|ja|徳川家光|ko|도쿠가와 이에미쓰|ms|Tokugawa Iemitsu|nl|Tokugawa Iemitsu|no|Tokugawa Iemitsu|pl|Iemitsu Tokugawa|pt|Tokugawa Iemitsu|ru|Токугава Иэмицу|sk|Iemicu Tokugawa|sr|Токугава Јемицу|sv|Tokugawa Iemitsu|th|โทกูงาวะ อิเอมิตสึ|tr|Tokugawa Iemitsu|uk|Токуґава Ієміцу|vi|Tokugawa Iemitsu|wuu|德川家光|zh|德川家光|zh_min_nan|Tokugawa Iemitu|zh_yue|德川家光|qid=Q314481}} and successive shoguns.

In {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6, the shrine was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. In {{ill|Taishō era|Q329174|qid=Q329174}} 1, the main hall was constructed, and in {{ill|Taishō era|Q329174|qid=Q329174}} 13 it was designated as a shrine eligible to receive offerings of sacred food and ritual expenses<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese
  |author = Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines
  |url = http://shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4413057
  |title = Kisa Shrine
  |accessdate = 2016-07-31 }}</ref>.

A restoration project in Heisei 22 carried out the raising and realignment of the main hall, as well as re-roofing the worship hall and protective structures with tiles.

=== Subsidiary Shrines ===
The subsidiary and related shrines within the precincts are as follows.

'''Precinct Shrines'''
* Goshinsama (Guardian Deity / Ancestral Deity): Enshrines Tenpaku Shrine and divided spirits from Ise Grand Shrine, Tsushima Shrine, and Kasuga Taisha.
